name: miadi-orchestration-kit
description: Miadi orchestration kits for Claude Code: the chronicle-episode skill and its mkdir-refusing hook, installable on any host without editing that host's system policy.

plugins.name: miadi-chronicle-episode-kit
plugins.description: Creates, adopts, registers, works in, and closes Miadi Chronicle episodes from one host-neutral skill, and refuses mkdir under the chronicle root with a PreToolUse hook that returns the mkepisode invocation instead.

plugins.name: mia-episode-companion
plugins.description: Mia, William's development companion, in a Claude Code seat: wakes the session when a phone voice take lands in the episode, and answers through draft, a developmental-editor agent, and revision.
